icit_keyed_layer.source: ICIT via Lipi repository CSV export, mirrored (MIT) in field-cady/indus_valley_script_corpus; Wells/ICIT numbers -> M via canonical sign registry (+ crosswalk v2 chain), key-normalized; unmapped/placeholder positions emitted as UNK sentinels (Phase-116, spec 015 section 2: spec-014 policy with provenance retained)

known_conflicts_from_candidates_file.conflicting_claims: P147 claimed by phase51 output, phase56 master_crosswalk, and phase65 SUPPLEMENTARY_MAP ('elephant = Parpola P147'); v1 allograph_families also lists P147 in the fish family. Not resolvable in-repo; crosswalk entry left unchanged.
known_conflicts_from_candidates_file.in_crosswalk: P103 (Phase-96 animal-sign table, Parpola 1994 App. B)

known_conflicts_from_candidates_file.conflicting_claims: phase51/phase56 phoneme-derived tables additionally claim identity/other numbers (M006<-P6, P364; M062<-P62, P126; M039<-P39). Those tables encode phoneme equivalence in part, not pure sign identity; crosswalk entries left unchanged.
phase56 master_crosswalk also claims M087<-P311. Left unchanged.
phase51/phase56 also claim M047<-P53 (allograph/phoneme relative). Canonical P47 retained.

sensitivity_kept_status_only.note: The Phase-116 build-status filter is reported for inspectability; identity rests on the published reference, not on a build status.

route_c_dossiers.note: Route (c) assembles sign-level evidence for the contested subset; it contributes no object identity of its own and is reported as an intersection with the matched set.

composition_residue.note: Objects attested in one compilation's frame only (spec §5): the ICIT corpus references thousands of CISI objects the mayig layer does not transcribe; the mayig layer holds no object the ICIT corpus fails to reference.

matched_subset.description: All matched objects are Mohenjo-daro seals: the mayig layer transcribes CISI vols 1–2 Mohenjo-daro objects only, so the bridge universe is that population.

mahadevan_side_full_holdat_layer.note: Holdat carries no CISI object references and cannot enter the bridge (spec 019 §2.1); its mix is reported as the second Mahadevan-side layer of record.

verdict.subset_description: 169 matched objects, all Mohenjo-daro seals (the CISI vols 1–2 object population transcribed in the mayig layer), Mahadevan-side readings from the ICIT published corpus.
